pages.title: The Steppe's own
text: Four animals belong to the Steppe: three that graze or fly over the open grass, and one that hunts in the tunnels underneath.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with its own food, named under **Hunting and herding** below. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), and though none has a gift of its own, a bonded one can still take a voice at a totem and strengthen your magic (see [attuning at a totem](familiar_attuning)).

pages.title: Tuftback
text: A shaggy steppe bison that grazes in herds of two to four. It has **26 health** and **5 armour**, moves very slowly and backs away from monsters.
It drops **1 to 3 Tuft Wool**, more with Looting.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 2 Raw Game and up to 1 March Leather. Breed with **Steppe Grain**.

pages.title: Longshank
text: A tall stag, quick on its feet, in herds of two to four. **22 health** and **1 armour**.
It drops **1 to 3 Shank Sinew**. Shank Sinew calls the Stampede Spirit at the Trampled Ring: see [guardians](guardians).
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Raw Game, up to 2 March Leather and up to 1 Bone. Breed with **Steppe Grain**.

pages.title: Palewing
text: A russet kite, pale under the wings, with a deeply forked tail, that soars over the grass in ones to threes. **10 health**, no armour.
It drops **1 to 3 Pale Down**, which grinds into white dye (see [reagents](reagents)).
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 2 Feathers and up to 1 Raw Game. Breed with **Steppe Grain or wheat seeds**.

pages.title: Burrow Gnasher
text: A digging stag beetle with great curved pincers, the Steppe's hunter. It lives in the dark tunnels under the grass and rises there day or night, one or two at a time. It has **23 health** and **3 armour**, and its bite does **4** and poisons you for 3 seconds.
It drops **1 to 2 Gnasher Teeth**, a Venom reagent. Gnashers also surface to join the Stampede Spirit's fight.
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 Bone and up to 1 Spider Eye.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. Meat drops roasted if the animal died burning. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
